issues.title: Form fields have no label
issues.impact: The customer cannot tell what to type. In checkout this stops the order. A placeholder is not a label: it disappears the moment typing starts and is often not announced.
issues.remediation: Associate a <label for="..."> with each field, or use aria-labelledby. Keep the label visible — placeholder-only fields fail for everyone under stress.
issues.verify: Click the visible label text. Focus should move into the field; if it does not, the label is not associated with the input.

issues.title: Text does not have enough contrast against its background
issues.impact: Customers with low vision, and anyone on a phone in daylight, cannot read the text. Prices, discounts and error messages are the common victims because they are often set in a light accent colour.
issues.remediation: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for text at 24px or 19px bold. Fix it in design tokens rather than per component.
issues.verify: Use the DevTools colour picker on the text, or any contrast checker, and compare the ratio against 4.5:1.

manualChecks.instruction: Put the mouse away. Using Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the arrow keys only, complete: open the menu, open a category, open a product, add it to the cart, open the cart, change the quantity, and reach the checkout entry.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Every step is completable. Focus never disappears, never gets stuck, and never leaves the page unexpectedly.
manualChecks.flaggedBy: Automated scan found: Buttons have no accessible name; Links have no accessible name.

manualChecks.instruction: Tab through the header, the product grid, the product page and the cart. Watch where focus lands at each stop.
manualChecks.passCriteria: The focused element is always clearly identifiable, with an indicator visible against its own background, including over images and coloured buttons.

manualChecks.instruction: Tab through each page and note whether the order matches the visual reading order.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Focus moves in a logical sequence. It does not jump between columns or backwards up the page.

manualChecks.instruction: Open the main navigation with the keyboard. Move through its items. Close it with Escape. Repeat on a phone-sized viewport.
manualChecks.passCriteria: The menu opens and closes from the keyboard, arrow keys or Tab move between items, Escape closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.

manualChecks.instruction: Trigger every dialog you can find — size guide, quick view, newsletter popup, cart drawer. For each, Tab repeatedly and then press Escape.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Focus moves into the dialog when it opens, stays inside while it is open, Escape closes it, and focus returns to the element that opened it.

manualChecks.instruction: Load the site in a fresh private window. Before touching the mouse, press Tab and try to reach and operate the consent banner.
manualChecks.passCriteria: The banner is reachable by keyboard, all options including "reject" are operable, and it does not trap focus or hide the page behind it.

manualChecks.instruction: On a product with size or colour options, select each variant using only the keyboard, and listen with a screen reader if available.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Every option is reachable and selectable, the current selection is announced, and an unavailable combination is communicated in text and not by colour alone.

manualChecks.instruction: Change the quantity using the keyboard, both on the product page and in the cart.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Plus and minus controls are real buttons with names, the field itself is labelled and editable, and the updated total is announced.

manualChecks.instruction: Add a product to the cart with a screen reader running. Wait without moving focus and listen for what is announced.
manualChecks.passCriteria: The result is announced without the user having to hunt for it — a live region, or focus deliberately moved to the confirmation.

manualChecks.instruction: Change a quantity and remove a line, using the keyboard only.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Remove controls name the product they remove ("Remove Blue Shirt", not "Remove"), and the updated total is announced.
manualChecks.flaggedBy: Automated scan found: Buttons have no accessible name; Links have no accessible name.

manualChecks.instruction: Use the search field by keyboard. Type a query that returns suggestions, then one that returns nothing.
manualChecks.passCriteria: The field is labelled, suggestions are reachable by arrow keys, the number of results is announced, and the empty state is conveyed in text.

manualChecks.instruction: Submit the contact form and the checkout form empty, then with one invalid field. Observe with a screen reader.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Errors are announced, focus moves to or names the first failing field, each message says what to do, and errors are not signalled by red colour alone.
manualChecks.flaggedBy: Automated scan found: Form fields have no label.

manualChecks.instruction: On a real phone with the screen reader on (VoiceOver or TalkBack), open the menu, browse to a product and add it to the cart.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Every step is completable by swipe navigation. The menu toggle is named and its expanded state is announced.

manualChecks.instruction: On a 1280px desktop window, zoom the browser to 400%. Read a product page and the cart.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Content reflows into one column, nothing is clipped, and no horizontal scrolling is needed to read a line of text.
manualChecks.flaggedBy: Automated scan found: Page prevents zooming; Page scrolls horizontally at 320px wide.

manualChecks.instruction: With a screen reader, listen to the product images, the icon buttons in the header, and the product cards in a category listing.
manualChecks.passCriteria: Alt text describes what the image shows rather than repeating the filename or the product title; icon buttons are named by their action.
manualChecks.flaggedBy: Automated scan found: Images are missing text alternatives.

manualChecks.instruction: Pull up the screen reader’s list of headings and of landmarks on the home, category and product pages.
manualChecks.passCriteria: The heading list alone conveys what is on the page, and landmarks let you jump straight to the main content.

developerHandoff.title: [CRITICAL] Form fields have no label — input[value]
developerHandoff.body:
**Problem**: Form fields have no label

**Component**: `input[value]`
**WCAG**: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A), 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (A), 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)
**Verification**: AUTOMATICALLY VERIFIED

**Who it affects**: The customer cannot tell what to type. In checkout this stops the order. A placeholder is not a label: it disappears the moment typing starts and is often not announced.

**Reproduce**: Click the visible label text. Focus should move into the field; if it does not, the label is not associated with the input.
Selector: `input[value="1"]` on https://kundens-butik.example/cart.html

**Fix**: Associate a <label for="..."> with each field, or use aria-labelledby. Keep the label visible — placeholder-only fields fail for everyone under stress.

**Occurrences**: 2 on 1 page(s)
- https://kundens-butik.example/cart.html

**Example markup**:
```html
<input type="number" value="1">
```

**Done when**: the defect is gone from this component on every affected page, verified with a keyboard and a screen reader — not only by re-running the scanner.
